purpose.summary: Generates a report of 'Unidades de Venda' (Sales Units) for a Brazilian business application. The program reads sales unit records, sorts them either alphabetically or numerically based on user input, and produces an HTML-formatted report with headers, pagination, and tabular data.

notable_features: EXEC HTML ... END-EXEC blocks (htmlpp preprocessor for web/CGI output)
is external-form clause for CGI input handling
SORT with INPUT PROCEDURE and OUTPUT PROCEDURE
Multiple COPY statements for modular copybooks (PCS, PCF, PCW, PCP, PCL series)
CALL to external routines: cabecalho_padrao, write_cabecalho, write_linha
HTML form generation with SELECT/OPTION elements embedded in COBOL
verdict.notes: This is a production-grade Brazilian ERP web report program using Micro Focus COBOL with the htmlpp preprocessor to generate HTML output. The program follows a clear CGI/web pattern (f-opcao=0 shows parameters form, f-opcao=1 runs the report). Portuguese-language identifiers and Brazilian date/decimal conventions confirm the locale. The file uses free-format COBOL despite having some fixed-format-looking indentation. Many copybooks are referenced but not shown.
